sections.Profile:
"Big Daddy" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Williams Electronic Manufacturing Company in September 1963. Designed by Steve Kordek, the game features a high-society theme, with artwork depicting elegant parties and sophisticated settings. The playfield includes two flippers, four pop bumpers, two passive bumpers, two slingshots, five rollover buttons, two kick-out holes, and a single drop target.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1963
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Women, Rich People, Nightlife, Original Theme, Single level playfield
